quest.title: An Agreement to Share Tips...
quest.description: After a period of relaxed cooperation with the children of the "Mutual Aid Advancement Network," the exploration plan has essentially been completed, and Chichikova seems to have gained some new insights...

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: This martial arts manual my sister sent back is amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: I just made a few rounds south of the station, knocked some sense into a few unruly Polyarbears, and got my blood pumping...

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: Then suddenly, click! Inspiration struck! Now, let me think how to put it into words... Ideally, in a way that'll help you put it to use right away.

dialogues.speaker: Big Xi'er
dialogues.text: Oh? Is that the Introduction to Fontaine Martial Arts you mentioned before? I'd love to take a look at it, too...

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: Sure! It's right over there, so help yourself. Just don't forget to bring it back when you're done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon didn't even notice Chichikova was gone!

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: Hehe, doesn't that just prove how good my footwork is? I come and go without leaving a trace!

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: Let's see how your exploration plan is coming along...

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: W—Whoa... Seriously!? You're this far already? It's only been a few days! Da Xi'er spent over a month on hers, and she didn't even get a fifth as far as you...

choices.text: Well... We've got a few exploration tricks up our sleeve.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: I've never met newcomers this amazing before... Actually, I've never even heard of any!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Please, you have to share your tips with everyone. It'll help the other newcomers improve at least three times faster than before!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we were planning to do that anyway!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Right, {NICKNAME}? Let's think of a way to explain it that's nice and easy to understand...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After going over how best to phrase things with Paimon, you add a short entry to Chichikova's Adventure Tips Handbook, summarizing what you've learned from your travels through Snezhnaya and highlighting a few points newcomers should keep in mind...\nThese include, but are not limited to: how to predict the movements of wild animals, how to make effective use of Prime Ice Constructs when exploring uncharted areas, and how to observe monster groups from the shadows to gauge their danger level and detection range...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: From your Natlan friend's point of view, perhaps this counts as its own kind of "Hero's Wit," too?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: See? I knew I had an eye for talent! Two genius newcomers, spotted just like that.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: From now on, you're core members of the Mutual Aid Network!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: And when my sister gets back, I'll introduce you. You might even learn a few more secret techniques from her — exclusive tricks of the Fatui elite!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, then when the time comes, we'll be in your sister's care!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: It's a promise, then! I'll be waiting for my sister to come home in Morepesok. Come visit again when she does!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Looks like the "Mutual Aid Advancement Network" event has come to a successful close. I'd better prepare another batch of Fervor Coupons and statue parts for the next group of newcomers...

response.speaker: Flammabomb Wood Figure
response.text: T—Tumaini... We were so lucky this time. We actually got to learn from you!

response.speaker: Flammabomb Wood Figure
response.text: If we ever meet again in Snezhnaya... please let us thank you with a gift!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Dad even set aside part of our travel money for presents. We'll make sure to pick out something really nice!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No need for that. You're still kids — you should save that money.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That way, you can travel farther and make even more friends.

choices.text: You don't have to pick up grown-ups' habit of giving gifts.

response.speaker: Flammabomb Wood Figure
response.text: You can count on that! We'll head back to spar with the white bears as soon as we're done here. We've been getting stronger every single day since we arrived in Snezhnaya!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: From hand-to-hand combat to muskets that hardly anyone back in our tribe has ever used, we're learning it all. When we get home, Dad's going to be in for a huge surprise!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: #Come to think of it... "Little Pinecone" and "Flammabomb Wood Figure," you two get pretty formal with {NICKNAME}. Almost like you're talking to an elder.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's how we show respect to our friends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah... Yeah, yeah, that's right! Back in Natlan, once you've had a serious spar with someone, you treat them with the greatest respect!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: So people in Natlan are all this polite? They're every bit as refined as the wealthy folks in Fontaine!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: If I ever get the chance to visit someday, I'll have to remember to use honorifics with everyone... and every saurian, too!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Especially that one Wood Figure mentioned... That Lord Ajaw!

choices.text: Seeing you grow stronger is more than enough for me.
Or maybe we'll be able to lend her a hand.
Your plan makes things pretty easy for us.
